reviewFindings: high: src/tools/linear-issue.ts:67-139 and src/shared/linear-client.ts:73-75 - snapshot validation is separated from an unconditional update by label and comment operations, allowing concurrent human edits or team moves to be overwritten.

high: src/tools/repository-read.ts:87-145 - filename-only exclusions permit common credential-bearing files and ordinary files containing secrets; raw content is returned without scanning or redaction.

high: src/channels/linear.ts:38, src/tools/linear-issue.ts:38-60,121-138, and src/agents/issue-strengthener.ts:87-98 - untrusted content reaches a write-capable model while repository inspection, output shape, secret handling, and label policy are enforced only by prompt.

low: src/tools/linear-issue.ts:37-44,75-87,153-170 - read/comment operations are not consistently restricted to the originally bound Linear team.
